bibliographic.title: The Investment
bibliographic.author: Xal, Pepper Ivy
bibliographic.description:
The year is 20XX, and the economy is in shambles. The market has fallen to its' knees, despite every effort on the part of the government and investors. Now, desperation is spreading amongst the people like a plague, with pressure building to find any way to save the market from utterly collapsing.
Stock buybacks, pouring trillions in liquidity into the market, bailouts, tax cuts..

It's the start of a new day, what ought to be just another typical Tuesday on Wall Street. Today, however, the knowledge that you have been chosen burdens you greatly.
